description: The projection wakes over Earth and establishes the player-sized rocket against a reachable world.
Every world we understand becomes somewhere we can reach.
The rocket crosses the known solar worlds; completed coordinates materialize while future planets remain distant.
Every discovery gives the voyage another coordinate.
Known sunlight thins and the route becomes the only stable coordinate.
The projection uses earned coordinates to fold distance without inventing new destinations.
The last known light bends around a destination the map cannot name.
Beyond the last light, the map has no word for what comes next.
The mission projection reaches its data boundary and either collapses or resolves according to the earned variant.
The unresolved projection folds back to Earth and hands agency to the player: make the route.
